title: Line Kitchen
tagline: Walk the lines. Cook your opponents.
description: All 28 opening courses — London, Italian, Sicilian, Ruy Lopez, and every line on the menu.

courses.title: London System
courses.description: If you click this, you're gonna make a lot of enemies. People hate London players because the opening is so solid and Black can do pretty much nothing to counter.

courses.title: Sicilian Defense
courses.description: Some people call it the Rolls Royce of openings. I call it the longest course I ever made. 38 lines - no that's not a typo. (update: now the ruy lopez is longer)

courses.title: Queen's Gambit Accepted
courses.description: They made the Netflix show into a real thing? Gambit a pawn, and when they take, you will win the game.

courses.title: Ruy Lopez
courses.description: The most solid opening on this website. If you want to win games, click here.

courses.title: Fried Liver Attack
courses.description: Checkmate your opponent in 8 moves. One of the most dangerous openings in chess.

courses.title: Vienna Gambit
courses.description: Sacrifice a pawn on the third move to win a powerful position and win your pawn back three moves later.

courses.title: Caro-Kann
courses.description: Fight back against the King's Pawn Opening by preparing to strike back at the center.

courses.title: Danish Gambit
courses.description: Sacrifice a pawn. Then another. Then ANOTHER. End up with a crushing position that will win you the game.

courses.title: Traxler Counterattack
courses.description: Destroy anyone who tries the Fried Liver Attack against you. Make them cry. Make them regret learning chess.

courses.title: Rousseau Gambit
courses.description: Drop whatever you're doing and learn this opening RIGHT NOW.

courses.title: King's Gambit
courses.description: Give up your pawn. Expose your king. All on the second move. What else is there to say?

courses.title: King's Indian Defense
courses.description: PLEASE don't click this unless you know what you're doing.

courses.title: Scandinavian Defense
courses.description: Honestly, this one is a tough one. You won't win in 8 moves like some of the other openings. But if putting your queen out on the second move sounds interesting, this is the opening for you.

courses.title: Jobava London
courses.description: This is like the london but for people who actually want to have fun and make friends.

courses.title: Italian Game
courses.description: This isa one-a spicy-a meatball-a! 🍝👨‍🍳 Mamma mia!

courses.title: Scotch Game
courses.description: This opening is a literal cheat code. It's just so good and so easy.

courses.title: Stafford Gambit
courses.description: Lose a pawn, then swindle your opponent into losing the game. This is the fun way to play chess.

courses.title: Vienna Game
courses.description: Did you like the Vienna Gambit? What if your opponent doesn't play that knight move? This course will teach you everything you need to know.

courses.title: Englund Gambit
courses.description: This opening will either win you or lose you the game. Let's roll the dice?

courses.title: Ponziani
courses.description: A solid opening to own the center and develop your piece - and maybe set up a few traps along the way.

courses.title: French Defense
courses.description: Lock your bishop in jail, then spend the rest of the game proving it was all part of the plan

courses.title: Queen's Gambit Declined
courses.description: They made the Netflix show into a real thing? They made the same joke twice? Anyways - do the Queen's Gambit accepted, then come here.

courses.title: Alapin Sicilian
courses.description: Shut down anyone who tries the sicilian against you.

courses.title: Petrov Defense
courses.description: Take white out of their comfort zone on move two

courses.title: Bishop's Opening
courses.description: Surprise your opponent on the second move. Probably win by the seventh. Nobody knew this opening until a youtube video made it viral.

courses.title: Albin Countergambit
courses.description: I hate playing against the Queen's Gambit. I really do. Learn to fight back by gambitting your OWN pawn on the second move.

courses.title: Counter the Vienna Gambit
courses.description: Counter the Vienna Gambit — 14 interactive lines for Black.

courses.title: English
courses.description: Play c4. Do nothing for 10 moves. Win anyway. That's the English.
